purpose: Identify the actual property interest implicated by a citizen question before selecting evidence, legal rules, procedures or remedies.
core_principle: QUESTION → PROPERTY CONCEPT → INTEREST TYPE → HOLDER/ROLE → SOURCE → LEGAL EFFECT
rules: Registered proprietorship is not automatically identical to beneficial ownership.
A mortgage or charge is a security interest, not ownership.
An easement or right of way is a property right distinct from ownership of the burdened land.
A succession entitlement is not automatically registered proprietorship.
A personal representative's estate role is distinct from the representative's personal ownership.
Joint tenancy and tenancy in common produce different legal consequences and must not be conflated.
A contractual right or option is not automatically a registered property interest.
The interest type must be identified before selecting the minimum evidence profile.
evidence_mapping: BENEFICIAL_INTEREST → trust/beneficial-interest evidence and applicable legal analysis
CO_OWNERSHIP → title/registration plus co-ownership/succession/beneficial evidence as applicable
hard_stops: Never infer the interest type from the word owner alone.
Never infer beneficial ownership from registered title alone.
Never infer title from possession alone.
Never infer discharge of security from sale or inheritance alone.
Never infer an easement merely from physical use.
Never collapse succession entitlement, personal-representative authority and registration.
